use_when.text: Use it for the action in a table row, such as Review.
Use it for secondary actions inside cards and callouts, such as View details.
Use Hover when the pointer is over it.
Turn on Icon Right for actions that open another page.
Write the Label as a short verb, such as Review or View.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it for the main action on a screen. Use Button in the Primary style.
Do not put two link buttons side by side without space between them.
Do not use it for plain navigation in a sentence. Use a text link.
Do not underline it in the Default state.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Keep one link button per row or card, so the next step is obvious.
Pair it with a full Button only when the Button is the main action and the link button is secondary.

variant_intent.intent: Use Hover when the pointer is over it.

placement.text: Table Row, Body type: the Action column, last cell, labelled "Review".
Table: the Action column of each of the five default Body rows.

pairs_with.how: Icon Right slot, arrow-right at Size sm by default, replaceable through IconRightSwap

a11y.text: Renders a native <button> with type="button" by default; it cannot render an <a>.
State Disabled sets the native disabled attribute.
The Icon Right wrapper is aria-hidden="true"; the Label is the accessible name.
Use a button element for actions, or an a element when it opens another page.
Include what it acts on when the label alone is unclear, such as "Review LF-2041".
Give it a hit area of at least 24 × 24, with padding in code if needed.
Keep a visible focus indicator on keyboard focus (:focus-visible).
The label is above 4.5:1 on white and on table rows.

differences.detail: Figma says to use an a element when the link button opens another page (and 232:559 pairs Icon Right with opening another page). The code always renders a <button> and its props are button attributes only, so it cannot render a link.

gaps.detail: State=Default, Disabled: the Figma documentation page for Link Button (232:306) does not say what these values are for (checked usage region 232:537).
